data.body: Ticket 4 (patriotic-abdicative-arrowana) plan-review BLOCKed hard: 8 blocking findings, all factual errors in my plan -- render_findings_block actually lives in review_bot/finding_publish.py (not adapter.py), the current renderer already emits NO severity word at all (nothing to "replace"), render_findings_block is called with a kind= param that the tag should derive from (not a new blocking:bool that never reaches it), _render_verdict_text renders completion_verdict findings from completion_reconcile.py which never pass through shim.py and have no decision/priority field at all (my plan wrongly assumed uniform derivation across all 3 CLI renderers), and multiple wrong test-file references again. Dispatched thorough research (file:line grounded) on the actual render_findings_block/adapter.py/three-CLI-renderer data flow before attempting a 3rd ticket-4 rewrite -- want this grounded correctly the first time given the repeated pattern of under-researched claims getting caught by the gate.
